claim: Both routes to E1 are now measured and blocked. Route 1, a from-scratch .CODE layout, misroutes the entry (localized to one instruction: the working image reads stdin at step 6483, the new one HALTs at 6484). Route 2, basing the program on the working mbir_cmp_lt.hell layout, is blocked by the initializer: adding the eight cycle cells the 5+2 technique needs makes LMAO reject the image outright, even appended at the very end of .CODE.

artifact.note: assembles, but the entry is misrouted so no stdin is ever read

route_1_from_scratch_layout.localized: the instrumented trace shows the working mbir_cmp_lt.mb executes IN at step 6483 while mbir_cmp_lt_dec.mb executes HALT at step 6484, having walked an identical wandering path
route_1_from_scratch_layout.cause: the position-dependent opcode decode (op = (cell + c) % 94) routes the path to the new program's HALT cell

route_2_working_layout.experiment: take mbir_cmp_lt.hell verbatim and append the eight cycle cells the 5+2 technique needs (two HIGH/LOW pairs per operand) at the very END of .CODE, so no earlier address shifts
route_2_working_layout.result: LMAO rejects the image: 'The program may be too large, or a .OFFSET directive may conflict'
route_2_working_layout.reading: the working comparator image has 1,537 bytes of margin, and that margin is not usable: the initializer cost of even eight extra cells exceeds it. Appending at the end of .CODE does not help because the cost is the initializer, not the raw cell count.

convergence_with_b: E1 and the unified image hit the same wall: the Classic 59,049-cell tape together with LMAO's initializer.
For E1 the wall is specifically that the only image whose entry wiring works cannot absorb the cells the 5+2 technique requires.

For (b) the wall is that the image whose arithmetic works cannot absorb a comparison dispatch. Five attempts measured (cells 58,955 / 58,969 / 57,619 / 58,152, plus a 6-line dead-code prune against an ~80-cell gap).
what_would_be_needed: A working entry wiring in an image that still has room for the cycle cells, i.e. a program built for the 5+2 technique from the start rather than grafted onto either existing image.
That means designing the .CODE/.DATA layout together with the entry route, which is the multi-week work the repository recorded as 73 findings for the {0,1,2} comparator.
what_is_demonstrated: The generator, the HeLL source and a 21,487-byte image that assembles.
The entry failure localized to one instruction with a side-by-side trace.
That the working comparator image cannot absorb the eight cells the technique needs.
scope_limits: Eight cells is the minimum for two HIGH/LOW cycle pairs; a leaner encoding was not searched.
